name: vk3DVision
summary: Vulkan layer injecting Dual-View Rendering into Vulkan games. Linux-first, Windows secondary. Development has ended — the author announced they will no longer work on the project and that key internal code cannot be open-sourced due to NDA constraints. The software remains functional for supported games but will receive no further updates or new game support.
compatibility_notes: Vulkan only. Windows support is secondary to Linux. Development ended — no new game fixes will be written. Existing fixes continue to work. Cannot host ReShade directly — ShaderGlass required as a DX11 overlay for SR Weave or other ReShade-dependent output conversions. Not to be confused with Helifax's Vk3DVision (a separate project at 3dsurroundgaming.com).
